picks.title: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys used to backdoor WordPress sites
picks.summary: A threat actor breached TeamUpdraft's website, a developer of popular WordPress backup and security plugins, potentially compromising UpdraftCentral connection keys that can send commands to connected websites. [...]

picks.title: Bürgel Says PHP Exploits Are Circulating Ahead of Critical Patches
picks.summary: PHP’s fixes are scheduled for 10 a.m. ET; security advisories urge operators to restrict exposed services and prepare to patch immediately.

picks.title: Wallet Linked to Drift Exploit Sends $61 Million in Ethereum to Tornado Cash
picks.summary: The North Korea-linked attacker behind April's $295 million Drift heist pushed 25,700 ETH through the mixer in two hours, and still controls roughly $198 million more.

picks.title: Zeabur shutting down after second security breach in two months
picks.summary: Development platform Zeabur has disclosed details of a cybersecurity incident in which an attacker used leaked internal credentials stored in plaintext to compromise its infrastructure and steal over 3.2 million environment variable records and information for 321,810 accounts. [...]

picks.title: Hackers Abuse AI Pen-Test Tool Cairn to Automate Massive Attack Spree
picks.summary: A Chinese-speaking attacker has compromised hundreds of websites across the globe, looting from big fish like John Deere, SharkNinja, and engine manufacturer Cummins.

picks.title: CISA: SafePay ransomware hit over 600 critical infrastructure orgs
picks.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) says the SafePay ransomware gang has breached over 600 critical infrastructure organizations worldwide since 2024. [...]
